'''Rhandites''', also known as '''Rhandite nihilists''', were a group who exclusively dwelt in the [[Nihil Retreat]] as acolytes of [[Way of the Dark|the faith]] established by the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. The Sorcerers presided over the Rhandites from their sanctum on [[Rhand]] in the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]]. [[Blessed Toxmalb]], Sorcerer of Rhand, held the title of [[Rhandite Lorekeeper]] and could control up to one hundered Rhandite [[Pawn]]s scattered across the [[Nihil Retreat]] at any given time.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rhandite nihilists had blessed the "[[Dark Worlds]]" that made up [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]' principality in the Unknown Regions.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rhandites, first appeared in [[2010]]'s ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', followed by a mention in [[2014]]'s ''[[The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire]], Part 3'', which identified [[Cronal]] as a Rhandite. The Rhandite's last mention was in [[2015]]'s ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''.
